lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke picks up the phone and gets in line to purchase it.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm actually doing this. I'm actually shopping.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The line moves slowly, but Luke doesn't mind.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This isn't so bad. Just wait your turn, pay for your item, and leave.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After buying the phone, Luke checks the contacts and finds Professor Layton's location.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: He's... he's somewhere in the back of the store? In space?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: That doesn't make any sense, but then again, nothing has made sense today.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke walks through the store and sees something impossible.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Is that... a spaceship?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Of course there's a spaceship at Grocery Outlet. Why wouldn't there be?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke approaches the spaceship.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor Layton's coordinates point to somewhere in space. I have to go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke climbs into the spaceship and is about to launch when he stops.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait. I can't just... take this.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor Layton always taught me to do things properly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke sees someone nearby who needs help.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: And he taught me that we ALWAYS have time for other people.

lines.speaker: helper
lines.text: Excuse me, could you help me reach that item on the top shelf?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke helps the person, who smiles and walks away.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Now, about buying this spaceship...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke goes back to the checkout line.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: You want to buy... the spaceship?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Sir, you can't just buy the display spaceship.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But I already got inside it!

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: SECURITY!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait,, I can explain!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke runs back to the spaceship.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I tried to do the right thing! I really did!

lines.speaker: helper
lines.text: Get in.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You! You're the person I helped!

lines.speaker: helper
lines.text: And now I'm helping you. Go!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke launches the spaceship into... space?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This is happening. This is actually happening.
